entities.name: Frédéric Rossignol
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frédéric Pierre Rossignol, C.S.Sp. is a Belgian prelate of the Catholic Church who has served as Bishop of Tournai since 2025. Before his appointment as bishop, he worked first as a missionary in Vietnam and Bolivia, and later as the spiritual director of the Saint Paul the Apostle Pontifical Missionary College in Rome.
